title: Amazon Affiliate & Pinterest Trend Product Research
summary: Data-driven niche product hunting, keyword mapping, competitor pricing analysis, and Pinterest pin asset planning.
problem: Identifying unsaturated e-commerce product niches and validating consumer demand using search volume, Pinterest visual discovery trends, and competitor listing reviews.
whatIDid: Filtered 120+ Amazon product listings across home organizer and desk accessory categories using BSR (Best Sellers Rank) and review velocity metrics.
Built a structured competitor analysis sheet tracking ASINs, pricing tier, rating distributions, and recurring buyer complaints.
Conducted keyword trend discovery on Pinterest to identify high-intent search phrases and visual aesthetic patterns.
Created sample Pinterest board templates and optimized pin title/description copy with relevant buyer hashtags.
result: Completed a comprehensive 45-item niche research matrix and 10 ready-to-test Pinterest campaign boards [EDUCATIONAL / INDEPENDENT RESEARCH].
